notes: Printed: '[-2]: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to another target creature.' Through the act window, as a dealt game asks it (the bench router): the -2 is a row of the menu, and its two targets are asked one slot at a time (CR 601.2c via 602.2b): first a creature you control (the Brute), then another creature (the Victim). The Brute deals 4 to the Victim, which dies; the Brute is dealt nothing (not a fight), and Garruk goes from 5 to 3 loyalty. The M21 campaign (KNOWLEDGE 2026-10-30/177) found act windows skipped activations with several target slots, so the -2 was never used.
